SELECT d.id AS drugId, d.drug_code AS drugCode, d.drug_name AS drugName, d.specification AS specification, m.manufacturer_name AS manufacturerName, COALESCE(inbound_stat.inboundQuantity, 0) AS inboundQuantity, COALESCE(inbound_return_stat.inboundReturnQuantity, 0) AS inboundReturnQuantity, COALESCE(outbound_stat.outboundQuantity, 0) AS outboundQuantity, COALESCE(outbound_return_stat.outboundReturnQuantity, 0) AS outboundReturnQuantity, COALESCE(inv.currentInventory, 0) AS currentInventory FROM t_drug d LEFT JOIN t_manufacturer m ON d.manufacturer_id = m.id AND m.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ii.drug_id, SUM(ii.quantity) AS inboundQuantity FROM t_inbound_item ii WHERE ii.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY ii.drug_id ) inbound_stat ON d.id = inbound_stat.drug_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ii.drug_id, SUM(ir.return_quantity) AS inboundReturnQuantity FROM t_inbound_return ir INNER JOIN t_inbound_item ii ON ir.inbound_item_id = ii.id WHERE ir.is_deleted = 0 AND ii.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY ii.drug_id ) inbound_return_stat ON d.id = inbound_return_stat.drug_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT oi.drug_id, SUM(oi.quantity) AS outboundQuantity FROM t_outbound_item oi WHERE oi.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY oi.drug_id ) outbound_stat ON d.id = outbound_stat.drug_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT oi.drug_id, SUM(or2.return_quantity) AS outboundReturnQuantity FROM t_outbound_return or2 INNER JOIN t_outbound_item oi ON or2.outbound_item_id = oi.id WHERE or2.is_deleted = 0 AND oi.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY oi.drug_id ) outbound_return_stat ON d.id = outbound_return_stat.drug_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT i.drug_id, SUM(i.quantity) AS currentInventory FROM t_inventory i WHERE i.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.drug_id ) inv ON d.id = inv.drug_id WHERE d.is_deleted = 0
AND d.drug_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.drugName}, '%')
AND d.drug_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.drugCode}, '%')
AND m.manufacturer_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.manufacturerName}, '%')
ORDER BY d.drug_code
ORDER BY d.drug_name
ORDER BY COALESCE(inv.currentInventory, 0)
ORDER BY d.id DESC
ASC
DESC
